name: adb-launch
description: Launch an Android app on the connected device via `adb shell am start -n <component>`. The component is `<package>/<activity>` (e.g. `com.example.app/.MainActivity`). Set ANDROID_SERIAL in the environment to target a specific device.

subcommand.name: default
subcommand.description: Start the specified Activity on the connected device. Combine with adb-pid-of afterward to get the PID for scoped android-logcat monitoring.

positional_args.name: component
positional_args.description: Activity component in the form <package>/<activity>, e.g. com.example.app/.MainActivity or com.example.app/com.example.app.MainActivity.

subcommand.install_instructions: Install ADB via Android Studio or: brew install android-platform-tools

custom.usage: After installing (adb-install or gradle-install-debug), launch the app, then call adb-pid-of to get its PID for scoped android-logcat monitoring.
